items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: And, uh, they had another fellow, he used to work with, uh, with Buddy, uh, Morris French

ctx.x: And, uh, they had another fellow, he used to work with, uh, with Buddy, uh, Morris French, you know what I heard of? Yeah. Great man. I guess he's dead now, isn't he?
Oh, yeah, he's been dead quite a while. Well, he did nice.
